def build_pool(L, workers):
    from multiprocessing import Pool as MPool
    d = os.path.dirname(find("coco_fp.npy"))
    cm = pickle.load(open(os.path.join(d, "coco_meta.pkl"), "rb"))
    co_fp = np.load(os.path.join(d, "coco_fp.npy")); co_mass = np.load(os.path.join(d, "coco_mass.npy"))
    co_keys = np.asarray(cm["keys"], dtype=object); co_smi = np.asarray(cm["smiles"], dtype=object)
    tr = pd.DataFrame({"ik": L["ik"], "smi": L["smi"]}).dropna().drop_duplicates("ik")
    tr = tr[~tr.ik.isin(set(co_keys))]
    log(f"COCONUT {len(co_keys):,}; training structures to fingerprint {len(tr):,}")
    with MPool(workers) as mp:
        res = mp.map(fp_and_mass, list(tr.smi), chunksize=500)
    ok = np.array([r is not None for r in res])
    tr_fp = np.stack([r[0] for r in res if r is not None]); tr_mass = np.array([r[1] for r in res if r is not None])
    fp = np.vstack([co_fp, tr_fp]); mass = np.concatenate([co_mass, tr_mass])
    keys = np.concatenate([co_keys, tr.ik.values[ok]]); smis = np.concatenate([co_smi, tr.smi.values[ok]])
    good = np.isfinite(mass)
    o = np.argsort(np.where(good, mass, 1e18), kind="mergesort")[: good.sum()]
    P = dict(fp=fp[o], mass=mass[o], keys=keys[o], smiles=smis[o])
    P["k2i"] = pd.Series(np.arange(len(o)), index=P["keys"]); P["k2i"] = P["k2i"][~P["k2i"].index.duplicated()]
    log(f"pool {len(o):,} structures")
    return P


def pool_fps(idx):
    return np.unpackbits(np.asarray(POOL["fp"][np.asarray(idx, np.int64)]), axis=1)[:, :6930]


def pool_window(t, ppm):
    a = np.searchsorted(POOL["mass"], t * (1 - ppm / 1e6), "left")
    b = np.searchsorted(POOL["mass"], t * (1 + ppm / 1e6), "right")
    return np.arange(a, b)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# index: neutral-mass sorted library rows + cleaned representatives (all / positive / negative)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _reps(L, rows):
    npk = np.diff(L["off"])[rows]
    df = pd.DataFrame({"row": rows, "p": L["row_p"][rows], "npk": npk})
    df = df.sort_values(["p", "npk", "row"], ascending=[True, False, True]).drop_duplicates("p")
    rep = df.row.values; rep_nm = L["nm"][rep]
    o = np.argsort(rep_nm, kind="mergesort"); rep = rep[o]
    roff, rmz, rit = pv.clean_store(rep, L["off"], L["mz"], L["it"], CFG.INT_FLOOR, CFG.MAX_PEAKS, CFG.INT_POWER, CFG.ENT_WEIGHT)
    return dict(rep=rep, rep_p=L["row_p"][rep], rep_nm=L["nm"][rep], roff=roff, rmz=rmz, rit=rit)


def build_index(L):
    ok = np.isfinite(L["nm"]) & (L["row_p"] >= 0)
    rows = np.where(ok)[0]
    o = np.argsort(L["nm"][rows], kind="mergesort")
    I = dict(lib_rows=rows[o], lib_nm=L["nm"][rows[o]])
    I["all"] = _reps(L, rows)
    I["pos"] = _reps(L, rows[L["pol"][rows] == 1])
    I["neg"] = _reps(L, rows[L["pol"][rows] == -1])
    log(f"index: {len(rows):,} library rows; representatives {len(I['all']['rep']):,}")
    return I


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# per-molecule channels (identical to e02_channels.molecule_channels)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def clean(mz, it):
    return pv._clean(np.asarray(mz, np.float32), np.asarray(it, np.float32),
                     CFG.INT_FLOOR, CFG.MAX_PEAKS, CFG.INT_POWER, CFG.ENT_WEIGHT)


def analog_search(R, Q, target):
    lo = np.searchsorted(R["rep_nm"], target - CFG.ANALOG_WIN, "left")
    hi = np.searchsorted(R["rep_nm"], target + CFG.ANALOG_WIN, "right")
    asim = np.zeros(hi - lo, np.float32)
    if hi > lo and Q:
        shift = (target - R["rep_nm"][lo:hi]).astype(np.float32)
        for qm, qp in Q:
            asim = np.maximum(asim, pv.search_shift_pre(qm, qp, lo, hi, R["roff"], R["rmz"], R["rit"], CFG.MZ_TOL, shift))
    return R["rep_p"][lo:hi], asim


def top_analogs(p, s):
    if len(p) == 0: return []
    df = pd.DataFrame({"p": p, "s": s}).groupby("p", sort=False).s.max().sort_values(ascending=False, kind="mergesort")
    return list(zip(df.index[:CFG.N_ANALOG].astype(int), df.values[:CFG.N_ANALOG].astype(float)))


def molecule_channels(L, I, specs, precs, pols, target):
    Q = [clean(a, b) for a, b in specs]
    keep = [i for i, (a, _) in enumerate(Q) if len(a)]
    Q = [Q[i] for i in keep]; precs = np.asarray(precs)[keep]; pols = np.asarray(pols)[keep]
    tol = target * CFG.PPM_WIN / 1e6
    lo = np.searchsorted(I["lib_nm"], target - tol, "left"); hi = np.searchsorted(I["lib_nm"], target + tol, "right")
    crow = I["lib_rows"][lo:hi]
    u, inv = np.unique(L["row_p"][crow], return_inverse=True)
    M = np.zeros((max(len(Q), 1), len(u)), np.float32); MS = np.zeros_like(M)
    for j, (qm, qp) in enumerate(Q):
        if len(crow) == 0: break
        s = pv.search(qm, qp, crow, L["off"], L["mz"], L["it"], CFG.MZ_TOL, CFG.INT_FLOOR, CFG.MAX_PEAKS,
                      CFG.INT_POWER, CFG.ENT_WEIGHT)
        np.maximum.at(M[j], inv, s)
        sh = (precs[j] - L["prec"][crow]).astype(np.float32)
        s2 = pv.search_shift_rows(qm, qp, crow, L["off"], L["mz"], L["it"], CFG.MZ_TOL, CFG.INT_FLOOR, CFG.MAX_PEAKS,
                                  CFG.INT_POWER, CFG.ENT_WEIGHT, sh)
        np.maximum.at(MS[j], inv, s2)
    cnt = np.bincount(inv, minlength=len(u)).astype(np.float32)
    z = np.zeros(0, np.float32)
    lib = (u, M.max(0) if len(u) else z, M.mean(0) if len(u) else z, MS.max(0) if len(u) else z, cnt)
    p, s = analog_search(I["all"], Q, target)
    ana = top_analogs(p, s)
    ps, ss = [], []
    for sign, name in ((1, "pos"), (-1, "neg")):
        QQ = [q for q, pl in zip(Q, pols) if pl == sign]
        if QQ:
            p, s = analog_search(I[name], QQ, target); ps.append(p); ss.append(s)
    anapol = top_analogs(np.concatenate(ps), np.concatenate(ss)) if ps else []
    return lib, ana, anapol


def parse_ce(v):
    try:
        a = np.abs(np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(v, float)))
        return float(a.mean()) if len(a) else 25.0
    except Exception:
        return 25.0




# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ranking features: prvsiyan's 31 + our blocks (identical to e05_rank.py BLOCKS)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _rel(v):
    v = np.asarray(v, np.float32)
    return [v, pv._rank_norm(v).astype(np.float32), v - (v.max() if len(v) else 0.0)]


def _analog_feats(cfp, ana):
    nc = len(cfp)
    if not ana: return np.zeros((nc, 5), np.float32)
    afp = pool_fps([p for p, _ in ana]).astype(np.float32); cf = cfp.astype(np.float32)
    inter = cf @ afp.T
    tan = inter / (cf.sum(1)[:, None] + afp.sum(1)[None, :] - inter + 1e-9)
    w = np.clip(np.array([s for _, s in ana], np.float32), 0, None)
    ap = (tan * (w ** 3)[None, :]).max(1)
    ap6 = (tan * (w ** 6)[None, :]).max(1)
    return np.column_stack(_rel(ap) + [ap6, np.full(nc, w[0])]).astype(np.float32)


def blk_base(r, cfp):
    ana = r["ana"]
    afp = pool_fps([p for p, _ in ana]) if ana else None
    sims = np.array([s for _, s in ana], np.float32)
    return pv.rank_features(cfp, r["lib"], afp, sims, r["zlog"], r["frag"])


def blk_mass(r, cfp):
    ppm = (POOL["mass"][r["cand"]] - r["target"]) / r["target"] * 1e6
    return np.column_stack([ppm, np.abs(ppm), np.abs(ppm + 1.5)]).astype(np.float32)


def blk_libx(r, cfp):
    cnt = np.log1p(r["lib_cnt"])
    return np.column_stack(_rel(r["lib_mean"]) + _rel(r["libsh"]) + [cnt, cnt - cnt.max()]).astype(np.float32)


def blk_anapol(r, cfp):
    return _analog_feats(cfp, r["anapol"])


def blk_fragx(r, cfp):
    return np.column_stack(_rel(r["frag_ad"]) + _rel(r["frag_mean"]) + [r["frag_pol"]]).astype(np.float32)


BLOCKS = {"base": blk_base, "mass": blk_mass, "libx": blk_libx, "anapol": blk_anapol, "fragx": blk_fragx}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# run
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def compute_channels(L, I, models, te):
    mols = list(te.groupby("molecule_id", sort=True))
    recs = []
    for gi, (mid, sub) in enumerate(mols):
        specs = []
        for r in sub.itertuples():
            a_ = np.asarray(r.ms2_mzs, np.float32); b_ = np.asarray(r.ms2_normalized_intensities, np.float32)
            k_ = a_ <= float(r.precursor_mz) + 2.0
            a_, b_ = a_[k_], b_[k_]
            specs.append((a_, b_ / b_.max() if len(b_) and b_.max() > 0 else b_))
        nms = pv.neutral_mass(sub.precursor_mz.values.astype(np.float64), sub.adduct.astype(str).values)
        nms = nms[np.isfinite(nms)]
        rec = dict(mid=mid, cand=np.zeros(0, np.int64))
        if len(nms):
            target = float(np.median(nms))
            modes = np.where(sub.ionization_mode.astype(str).values == "positive", 1.0, -1.0)
            lib, ana, anapol = molecule_channels(L, I, specs, sub.precursor_mz.values.astype(np.float64), modes, target)
            cand = pool_window(target, CFG.PPM_WIN)
            if len(cand) == 0: cand = pool_window(target, CFG.PPM_FALLBACK)
            ces = np.array([parse_ce(v) for v in sub.collision_energy_ev.values], np.float32)
            import pv_fp
            zlog = pv_fp.molecule_logits(models, specs, sub.precursor_mz.values.astype(np.float32),
                                         list(sub.adduct.astype(str).values), list(sub.instrument_type.astype(str).values),
                                         ces, modes)
            u, lmax, lmean, lsh, lcnt = lib
            pos = {int(x): i for i, x in enumerate(u)}
            ci = np.array([pos.get(int(c), -1) for c in cand], np.int64); has = ci >= 0
            rec.update(target=target, cand=cand, zlog=None if zlog is None else zlog.astype(np.float32), specs=specs,
                       mode=float(np.mean(modes)), modes=modes, adducts=list(sub.adduct.astype(str).values),
                       ana=ana, anapol=anapol)
            for nm_, arr in (("lib", lmax), ("lib_mean", lmean), ("libsh", lsh), ("lib_cnt", lcnt)):
                v = np.zeros(len(cand), np.float32); v[has] = arr[ci[has]]; rec[nm_] = v
        recs.append(rec)
        if gi % 50 == 0: log(f"  channels {gi}/{len(mols)}")
    return mols, recs


def compute_frag(recs, workers):
    from multiprocessing import Pool as MPool
    uc = np.unique(np.concatenate([r["cand"] for r in recs]))
    log(f"MetFrag-lite on {len(uc):,} candidates")
    with MPool(workers) as mp:
        fr = mp.map(pv.frag_masses_safe, list(POOL["smiles"][uc]), chunksize=16)
    fmap = dict(zip(uc.tolist(), fr))
    for r in recs:
        if not len(r["cand"]): continue
        peaks = []
        for a_, b_ in r.pop("specs"):
            m2, i2 = pv._clean(a_, b_, CFG.INT_FLOOR, CFG.MAX_PEAKS, 1.0, False)
            peaks.append((np.asarray(m2, float), np.asarray(i2, float)))
        F1 = np.zeros((len(r["cand"]), max(len(peaks), 1)), np.float32); F2 = np.zeros_like(F1); F3 = np.zeros_like(F1)
        for j, c in enumerate(r["cand"]):
            fm = fmap[int(c)]
            for k, (x, y) in enumerate(peaks):
                F1[j, k] = pv.explain_score(fm, x, y, mode=r["mode"], tol=CFG.MZ_TOL)
                F2[j, k] = pv.explain_score_adduct(fm, x, y, r["adducts"][k], tol=CFG.MZ_TOL)
                F3[j, k] = pv.explain_score(fm, x, y, mode=r["modes"][k], tol=CFG.MZ_TOL)
        r["frag"] = F1.max(1); r["frag_ad"] = F2.max(1); r["frag_mean"] = F3.mean(1); r["frag_pol"] = F3.max(1)


def _hgb(X, Y, W, seed, gbm):
    from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
    m = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=seed, **gbm); m.fit(X, Y, sample_weight=W)
    return m


def fit_rankers(rank_train_path):
    """Our ranker: simulation rows from 7 query sets (S = 0 class-1 sim, 1 = class-2 sim)."""
    z = np.load(rank_train_path, allow_pickle=True)
    X, Y, S = z["X"], z["Y"], z["S"]
    rankers = [_hgb(X, Y, np.where(S == 0, wA, 1.0 - wA), sd, RANK.GBM) for wA in RANK.W_A for sd in RANK.SEEDS]
    log(f"our ranker: {len(rankers)} GBMs on {X.shape[0]:,} rows x {X.shape[1]} features")
    return rankers, [str(b) for b in z["blocks"]]


def fit_pv_rankers(pv_rank_path, priors=(0.30, 0.60), seeds=(0, 1, 2, 3)):
    """prvsiyan's ranker, exactly as in his notebook: shipped rank_train.npz (M = 0 class-1 sim)."""
    z = np.load(pv_rank_path)
    rankers = [_hgb(z["X"], z["Y"], np.where(z["M"] == 0, w1, 1.0 - w1), sd, CFG.GBM) for w1 in priors for sd in seeds]
    log(f"prvsiyan ranker: {len(rankers)} GBMs on {z['X'].shape[0]:,} rows x {z['X'].shape[1]} features")
    return rankers, z["X"].shape[1]


def score_molecules(recs, rankers, blocks, use_fp):
    out = {}
    for r in recs:
        if not len(r["cand"]): continue
        rr = r if use_fp else dict(r, zlog=None)
        cfp = pool_fps(r["cand"])
        Xm = np.hstack([BLOCKS[b](rr, cfp) for b in blocks]).astype(np.float32)
        out[r["mid"]] = np.mean([m.predict_proba(Xm)[:, 1] for m in rankers], axis=0)
    return out


def blend_scores(a, b, wa):
    """Within-molecule rank blend (both inputs are per-candidate probabilities)."""
    out = {}
    for mid in a:
        ra = 1.0 - pv._rank_norm(a[mid]); rb = 1.0 - pv._rank_norm(b[mid])
        out[mid] = wa * ra + (1.0 - wa) * rb + 1e-6 * a[mid]
    return out


def make_submissions(mols, recs, score_sets, sample_path, workers, topn=25):
    """score_sets: {name: {mid: scores}} -> {name: submission DataFrame}; one canonicalisation pass for all."""
    from multiprocessing import Pool as MPool
    cand = {r["mid"]: r["cand"] for r in recs if len(r["cand"])}
    ordered = {n: {mid: cand[mid][np.argsort(-sc, kind="mergesort")][:topn + 15] for mid, sc in S.items()}
               for n, S in score_sets.items()}
    allc = [v for o in ordered.values() for v in o.values()]
    short = np.unique(np.concatenate(allc)) if allc else np.zeros(0, np.int64)
    with MPool(workers) as mp:
        ck = mp.map(canon_key, list(POOL["smiles"][short]), chunksize=64)
    ckey = dict(zip(short.tolist(), ck))
    samp = pd.read_csv(sample_path)
    subs = {}
    for n, o in ordered.items():
        rows = []
        for mid, _ in mols:
            out, seen = [], set()
            for c in o.get(mid, []):
                k = ckey.get(int(c)) or POOL["keys"][c]
                if k in seen: continue
                seen.add(k); out.append(POOL["smiles"][c])
                if len(out) == topn: break
            while len(out) < topn:
                out.append("CCO")
            rows.append((mid, ";".join(out[:topn])))
        sub = samp[["molecule_id"]].merge(pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["molecule_id", "smiles"]), on="molecule_id", how="left")
        sub["smiles"] = sub["smiles"].fillna("CCO")
        assert len(sub) == len(samp) and sub.molecule_id.duplicated().sum() == 0 and sub.smiles.isnull().sum() == 0
        assert (sub.smiles.str.split(";").map(len) == topn).all()
        subs[n] = sub
    return subs


def main(test_path, train_path, sample_path, our_rank_path, pv_rank_path, fp_model_paths, workers=4, limit=0, w_pv=0.88):
    global POOL
    import torch
    import pv_fp
    L = load_library(train_path); log(f"library {len(L['prec']):,} spectra")
    POOL = build_pool(L, workers)
    L["row_p"] = POOL["k2i"].reindex(L["ik"]).fillna(-1).values.astype(np.int64)
    del L["ik"], L["smi"]
    I = build_index(L)
    dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    single, merged, _ = pv_fp.load_fp_models(fp_model_paths, dev)
    log(f"fp models: {len(single)} single + {len(merged)} merged on {dev}")
    te = pq.read_table(test_path).to_pandas()
    if limit:
        keep = sorted(te.molecule_id.unique())[:limit]; te = te[te.molecule_id.isin(keep)]
    log(f"test: {len(te):,} spectra / {te.molecule_id.nunique():,} molecules")
    mols, recs = compute_channels(L, I, (single, merged, dev), te)
    del L, I
    compute_frag(recs, workers)
    ours, blocks = fit_rankers(our_rank_path)
    s_ours = score_molecules(recs, ours, blocks, use_fp=False)
    del ours
    pvr, nfeat = fit_pv_rankers(pv_rank_path)
    s_pv = score_molecules(recs, pvr, ["base"], use_fp=True)
    del pvr
    subs = make_submissions(mols, recs, {"blend": blend_scores(s_pv, s_ours, w_pv), "pv": s_pv, "ours": s_ours},
                            sample_path, workers)
    log("submissions ready")
    return subs, recs", "metric.py": """"Kaggle scoring for CASMI: Mean Reciprocal Rank @ max_rank (MRR@25 by default).

Submission is one row per molecule, `molecule_id,smiles`, where `smiles` holds up to `max_rank`
candidate structures joined by semicolons, best guess first:

    molecule_id,smiles
    m_0014ef,CCO;CC(=O)O;c1ccccc1

Each molecule scores 1/position of the first guess whose tautomer-canonical InChIKey14 matches
the answer, else 0. There is exactly one correct structure per molecule, so nothing accumulates
past the first hit -- this is reciprocal rank, not average precision, and it stays reciprocal
rank even if `canonical_ik14s_all` is later extended to accept several indistinguishable
isomers, because the loop breaks on the first match. `max_rank` is a metric parameter set on
the competition page.
Inlines RDKit canonicalization to run standalone on Kaggle.
"""

import importlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Solution key canonicalized with RDKit 2026.03.3. RDKit's TautomerEnumerator output has changed
# between releases, so this pin decides which submissions match; it is not a convenience.
# https://pypi.org/project/rdkit/2026.3.3/
EXPECTED_RDKIT_VERSION = '2026.03.3'
# PyPI spells the same release 2026.3.3 -- PEP 440 strips the leading zero -- while
# rdkit.__version__ reports it zero-padded. Both strings appear below on purpose.
RDKIT_REQUIREMENT = 'rdkit==2026.3.3'
# RDKit is not in docker-python, so the wheel ships as a competition input and is installed
# offline at scoring time. Wheel dataset: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/<owner>/rdkit-2026-3-3-wheel
RDKIT_WHEEL_DIR = '/kaggle/input/datasets/metric/rdkit-2026-3-3-wheel'

# Bound by install_dependencies(); importing this module must not require RDKit, because the
# orchestrator imports it before anything has had a chance to install.
Chem = None
_tautomer_canonicalizer = None


class HostVisibleError(Exception):
    pass


def install_dependencies() -> None:
    """Make RDKit importable, installing it from the bundled wheel if the image lacks it.

    Idempotent and cheap on repeat calls. Called at the top of score() rather than at import time:
    validate_local_metrics and the orchestrator both import this module first, and an import-time
    install would run before the competition inputs are mounted.
    """
    global Chem, _tautomer_canonicalizer
    if Chem is not None:
        return

    try:
        import rdkit
    except ImportError:
        if not os.path.isdir(RDKIT_WHEEL_DIR):
            raise HostVisibleError(
                f'{RDKIT_WHEEL_DIR} does not exist, so {RDKIT_REQUIREMENT} cannot be installed. '
                f'Attach the wheel dataset to the metric notebook as an input.'
            )
        # pip rather than uv: pip always installs into the interpreter running it, whereas
        # `uv pip install` wants a virtualenv and exits 2 when there isn't one. --no-deps because
        # rdkit only needs numpy and Pillow, both already in the image; without it the resolver
        # goes looking for them and --no-index leaves it nowhere to look.
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            '-m',
            'pip',
            'install',
            '--no-deps',
            '--no-index',
            f'--find-links={RDKIT_WHEEL_DIR}',
            RDKIT_REQUIREMENT,
        ]
        # Captured, not inherited: a bare check=True reports only the exit status, which says
        # nothing about whether the wheel was missing, unresolvable, or wrong for this Python.
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            available = sorted(os.listdir(RDKIT_WHEEL_DIR))
            raise HostVisibleError(
                f'{" ".join(command)} exited {result.returncode}. '
                f'Python {sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}; '
                f'{RDKIT_WHEEL_DIR} contains {available}. '
                f'stderr: {result.stderr[-1500:]} stdout: {result.stdout[-1500:]}'
            )
        importlib.invalidate_caches()
        try:
            import rdkit
        except ImportError as err:
            raise HostVisibleError(f'{RDKIT_REQUIREMENT} installed but still not importable: {err}')

    from rdkit import Chem as _Chem
    from rdkit import RDLogger
    from rdkit.Chem.MolStandardize import rdMolStandardize

    RDLogger.DisableLog('rdApp.*')
    if rdkit.__version__ != EXPECTED_RDKIT_VERSION:
        warnings.warn(
            f'RDKit version mismatch: solution={EXPECTED_RDKIT_VERSION}, scoring={rdkit.__version__}. Canonicalization may differ.',
            UserWarning,
        )
    Chem = _Chem
    _tautomer_canonicalizer = rdMolStandardize.TautomerEnumerator()


def canonicalize_smiles_to_ik14(smiles: str) -> str:
    """Canonicalize SMILES to InChIKey14, or None if parsing fails."""
    if not isinstance(smiles, str):
        return None
    try:
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
        if mol is None:
            return None
        canonical_mol = _tautomer_canonicalizer.Canonicalize(mol)
        inchikey = Chem.MolToInchiKey(canonical_mol)
        return inchikey[:14]
    # RDKit's MolSanitizeException family subclasses ValueError; RuntimeError covers the C++
    # layer and TypeError covers Boost.Python argument errors. One participant's malformed
    # SMILES must never take the whole scoring run down, so a failure here is just a non-match.
    except (ValueError, RuntimeError, TypeError):
        return None


def heavy_atom_composition(smiles: str):
    """Heavy-atom element counts (excluding H, ignoring charge) as a hashable key, or None
    if parsing fails.

    Cheap (no tautomer enumeration) -- used to gate the expensive canonicalization. Anything
    that shares an InChIKey14 with an accepted structure has the same heavy-atom skeleton, so
    a heavy-atom-composition mismatch lets us skip canonicalization with no change to any
    score. We deliberately do NOT gate on full molecular formula: protomers / charge variants
    (e.g. a zwitterion C(=O)[O-]...[N+] vs its neutral-acid protomer C(=O)O...[N+]) share an
    InChIKey14 but differ in H count and charge, so a formula gate would wrongly reject them.
    """
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles) if isinstance(smiles, str) else None
    if mol is None:
        return None
    counts = {}
    for atom in mol.GetAtoms():
        sym = atom.GetSymbol()
        if sym != 'H':
            counts[sym] = counts.get(sym, 0) + 1
    return tuple(sorted(counts.items()))


class ParticipantVisibleError(Exception):
    pass


def score(
    solution: pd.DataFrame,
    submission: pd.DataFrame,
    row_id_column_name: str,
    max_rank: int = 25,
) -> float:
    """Score CASMI submissions using mean reciprocal rank.

    max_rank: how many ranked guesses each molecule may carry. Set on the competition page.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> import pandas as pd
    >>> solution = pd.DataFrame({
    ...     'molecule_id': ['m_1', 'm_2'],
    ...     'smiles': ['CCO', 'c1ccccc1'],
    ...     'Usage': ['Public', 'Public'],
    ... })

    Position in the semicolon-separated list is the rank: ethanol is guessed first and scores
    1.0, benzene is guessed second and scores 1/2, so the mean is 0.75.

    >>> submission = pd.DataFrame({
    ...     'molecule_id': ['m_1', 'm_2'],
    ...     'smiles': ['CCO;CC(=O)O', 'CC(=O)O;c1ccccc1'],
    ... })
    >>> score(solution, submission, 'molecule_id')
    0.75

    A molecule with no correct guess scores zero, and only the first correct guess counts, so
    repeating it gains nothing.

    >>> score(solution, pd.DataFrame({
    ...     'molecule_id': ['m_1', 'm_2'],
    ...     'smiles': ['CC(=O)O', 'c1ccccc1;c1ccccc1;c1ccccc1'],
    ... }), 'molecule_id')
    0.5

    Matching is on the tautomer-canonical InChIKey14, so stereochemistry is ignored: the
    submission below omits the stereocentre the answer specifies and still scores.

    >>> score(
    ...     pd.DataFrame({'molecule_id': ['m_1'], 'smiles': ['C[C@H](N)C(=O)O']}),
    ...     pd.DataFrame({'molecule_id': ['m_1'], 'smiles': ['CC(N)C(=O)O']}),
    ...     'molecule_id',
    ... )
    1.0

    Malformed submissions raise ParticipantVisibleError.

    >>> try:
    ...     score(solution, pd.DataFrame({
    ...         'molecule_id': ['m_1', 'm_1'], 'smiles': ['CCO', 'CCO'],
    ...     }), 'molecule_id')
    ... except ParticipantVisibleError as err:
    ...     print(err)
    Each molecule_id must appear exactly once

    >>> try:
    ...     score(solution, pd.DataFrame({
    ...         'molecule_id': ['m_1'], 'smiles': [';'.join(['CCO'] * 3)],
    ...     }), 'molecule_id', max_rank=2)
    ... except ParticipantVisibleError as err:
    ...     print(err)
    At most 2 semicolon-separated guesses per molecule_id, got 3 for m_1

    An answer the canonicalizer cannot parse is a broken solution file, not a zero score.

    >>> try:
    ...     score(
    ...         pd.DataFrame({'molecule_id': ['m_1'], 'smiles': ['not a molecule']}),
    ...         pd.DataFrame({'molecule_id': ['m_1'], 'smiles': ['CCO']}),
    ...         'molecule_id',
    ...     )
    ... except HostVisibleError as err:
    ...     print(err)
    Solution SMILES for molecule_id m_1 could not be parsed: 'not a molecule'
    """
    install_dependencies()
    if not isinstance(max_rank, (int, np.integer)) or max_rank < 1:
        raise ValueError(f'max_rank must be a positive integer, got {max_rank!r}')
    required = ['molecule_id', 'smiles']
    if not all(c in submission.columns for c in required):
        raise ParticipantVisibleError(f'Missing columns: {required}')
    if len(submission) == 0:
        raise ParticipantVisibleError('Submission is empty')
    if submission[required].isna().any().any():
        raise ParticipantVisibleError('NaN in required columns')
    if 'smiles' not in solution.columns:
        raise ParticipantVisibleError('Solution missing smiles column')
    if submission['molecule_id'].duplicated().any():
        raise ParticipantVisibleError('Each molecule_id must appear exactly once')

    # One row per molecule; rank is position in the list, so there is no rank column to validate
    # and no way to claim two guesses share a rank. A semicolon cannot occur inside a valid SMILES
    # -- RDKit rejects "CCO;CC(=O)O" -- so splitting on it can never cut a legitimate guess in half.
    # Whitespace would not be safe here: RDKit reads "CCO ethanol" as ethanol with a name attached.
    guesses_by_molecule = {}
    for molecule_id, raw_guesses in zip(submission['molecule_id'], submission['smiles']):
        parsed = [candidate.strip() for candidate in str(raw_guesses).split(';')]
        parsed = [candidate for candidate in parsed if candidate]
        if not parsed:
            raise ParticipantVisibleError(f'No guesses for molecule_id {molecule_id}')
        if len(parsed) > max_rank:
            raise ParticipantVisibleError(f'At most {max_rank} semicolon-separated guesses per molecule_id, got {len(parsed)} for {molecule_id}')
        guesses_by_molecule[molecule_id] = parsed

    # Cheap heavy-atom-composition gate (computed up front; no tautomer enumeration).
    gate_keys = {s: heavy_atom_composition(s) for guesses in guesses_by_molecule.values() for s in guesses}

    scores = []
    unknown_ids = set(submission['molecule_id']) - set(solution['molecule_id'])
    if unknown_ids:
        print(f'Unknown molecule_ids: {sorted(unknown_ids)[:5]}{"..." if len(unknown_ids) > 5 else ""}')

    # Per molecule: the accepted InChIKey14 set and the heavy-atom compositions those accepted
    # structures can have (one composition in practice; built as a set to be safe). The keys are
    # derived from the answer SMILES through the same canonicalization a submission goes through,
    # rather than stored alongside them -- one source of truth, and the answer key cannot drift out
    # of step with the canonicalizer the way a precomputed column silently would.
    sol_dict = {}
    for _, row in solution.iterrows():
        molecule_id = row['molecule_id']
        accept_smiles = row['smiles'] if isinstance(row['smiles'], str) else ''
        candidates = [s for s in accept_smiles.split(',') if s]
        if not candidates:
            raise HostVisibleError(f'Solution has no answer SMILES for molecule_id {molecule_id}')
        accept_ik14s = {k for k in map(canonicalize_smiles_to_ik14, candidates) if k}
        accept_keys = {k for k in map(heavy_atom_composition, candidates) if k}
        # Skipping an unparseable answer would quietly drop the molecule from the mean, so a
        # corrupt key would read as a lower score rather than as a broken solution file.
        if not accept_ik14s or not accept_keys:
            raise HostVisibleError(f'Solution SMILES for molecule_id {molecule_id} could not be parsed: {accept_smiles!r}')
        sol_dict[molecule_id] = (accept_ik14s, accept_keys)

    # Memoize canonicalization so a repeated SMILES is only canonicalized once.
    canon_cache = {}

    def canon(smiles):
        if smiles not in canon_cache:
            canon_cache[smiles] = canonicalize_smiles_to_ik14(smiles)
        return canon_cache[smiles]

    for mol_id, (acceptable, accept_keys) in sol_dict.items():
        ap = 0.0
        for rank, guess in enumerate(guesses_by_molecule.get(mol_id, []), 1):
            # Gate: skip the costly tautomer canonicalization when heavy-atom composition
            # rules out a match. Not guarded on `accept_keys` being populated -- the solution
            # parsing above raises if it is empty, so a silently disabled gate cannot happen.
            if gate_keys[guess] not in accept_keys:
                continue
            if canon(guess) in acceptable:
                ap = 1.0 / rank
                break
        scores.append(ap)

    return float(np.mean(scores))

", "harness.py": """"Local validation harness for the two-ranker engine.

Simulates the hidden test on held-out timsTOF molecules, twice per molecule:
  c1  Class-1 simulation: the query's own source library is removed from the spectral library,
      other libraries' spectra of the same structure stay (cross-library library search).
  c2  Class-2 simulation: every spectrum of the structure is removed from the library; the
      structure stays in the candidate pool (as a training structure: the shipped COCONUT half
      has all training structures removed, so its own coverage cannot be checked here -- prvsiyan
      measured 99.6% for enveda-np-examples). c2 MRR is therefore conditional on pool membership.

  python harness.py build [--set np] [--limit N]   # heavy: library, pool, channels, MetFrag -> cache
  python harness.py score [--set np]               # light: rankers, blend, metric, report

The engine modules (pv, pv_fp, casmi_engine) are the notebook's code; this file only wraps them.
"""
import os, sys, time, pickle, argparse
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "data")
CACHE = os.path.join(DATA, "cache")
os.environ.setdefault("CASMI_ROOTS", DATA)
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, pyarrow.parquet as pq, pyarrow as pa

TRAIN = os.path.join(DATA, "comp", "train.parquet")
TEST_ADDUCTS = {"[M+H]+", "[M+NH4]+", "[M-H2O+H]+", "[M-2H2O+H]+", "[M+Na]+", "[M+K]+",
                "[M-H]-", "[M-H2O-H]-", "[M+CH2O2-H]-", "[M+Cl]-"}
TEST_COLS = ["molecule_id", "spectrum_id", "ms2_mzs", "ms2_normalized_intensities", "base_peak_intensity", "adduct",
             "ionization_mode", "instrument_type", "precursor_mz", "collision_energy_ev"]
# query sets: source library, and how many structures to sample (None = all)
QUERY_SETS = {"np": dict(lib="enveda-np-examples", n=None)}
# prvsiyan's leaderboard calibration: LB ~ A*c1 + B*c2 (A = Class-1 share; B = Class-2 share x pool recall,
# refitted by him to 0.271 as the ranker improved; megayak used 0.220)
LB_A, LB_B = 0.162, 0.271
PER_CAND = ("cand", "lib", "lib_mean", "libsh", "lib_cnt", "frag", "frag_ad", "frag_mean", "frag_pol")


def log(msg, t0=[time.time()]):
    print(f"[{time.time() - t0[0]:6.0f}s] {msg}", flush=True)


def cpath(*parts):
    os.makedirs(CACHE, exist_ok=True)
    return os.path.join(CACHE, *parts)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# queries
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_queries(set_name, limit=0, seed=0):
    """Test-like queries from one source library: test adducts only, the host's cleaning rules,
    one molecule per inchikey14 (all of its spectra from that library)."""
    q = QUERY_SETS[set_name]
    cols = [c for c in TEST_COLS if c not in ("molecule_id", "spectrum_id")] + ["inchikey14", "normalized_smiles",
                                                                                  "precursor_error_ppm"]
    t = pq.read_table(TRAIN, columns=cols, filters=[("ingest_lib", "=", q["lib"])]).to_pandas()
    t["spectrum_id"] = [f"s_{i}" for i in range(len(t))]
    n0 = len(t)
    t = t[t.adduct.astype(str).isin(TEST_ADDUCTS)]
    t = t[t.base_peak_intensity.isna() | (t.base_peak_intensity >= 1000)]
    t = t[t.precursor_error_ppm.isna() | (t.precursor_error_ppm.abs() <= 20)]
    iks = np.array(sorted(t.inchikey14.unique()))
    if q["n"] and len(iks) > q["n"]:
        iks = np.sort(np.random.default_rng(seed).choice(iks, q["n"], replace=False))
    if limit:
        iks = iks[:limit]
    t = t[t.inchikey14.isin(set(iks))].copy()
    t["molecule_id"] = "q_" + t.inchikey14.astype(str)
    truth = t.drop_duplicates("molecule_id")[["molecule_id", "inchikey14", "normalized_smiles"]].sort_values("molecule_id")
    log(f"queries[{set_name}]: {n0:,} library spectra -> {len(t):,} test-like spectra / {len(truth)} molecules "
        f"(spectra/molecule median {t.groupby('molecule_id').size().median():.0f})")
    return t.reset_index(drop=True), truth.reset_index(drop=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# heavy stage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load_pool(E, L, workers):
    """E.build_pool, cached (fingerprinting 276k training structures is the slow part)."""
    f = cpath("pool.pkl")
    if os.path.exists(f):
        P = pickle.load(open(f, "rb")); P["fp"] = np.load(cpath("pool_fp.npy"), mmap_mode="r")
        log(f"pool {len(P['mass']):,} structures (cached)")
    else:
        P = E.build_pool(L, workers)
        np.save(cpath("pool_fp.npy"), P["fp"])
        pickle.dump({k: v for k, v in P.items() if k != "fp"}, open(f, "wb"), protocol=4)
    return P


def build(args):
    import casmi_engine as E, pv_fp, torch
    torch.set_num_threads(max(1, args.workers // 2))
    te, truth = build_queries(args.set, args.limit)
    L = E.load_library(TRAIN); log(f"library {len(L['prec']):,} spectra")
    lib = pq.read_table(TRAIN, columns=["ingest_lib"]).column(0).cast(pa.string()).to_numpy(zero_copy_only=False)
    E.POOL = load_pool(E, L, args.workers)
    L["row_p"] = E.POOL["k2i"].reindex(L["ik"]).fillna(-1).values.astype(np.int64)
    ik = L.pop("ik"); del L["smi"]
    base_row_p = L["row_p"].copy()
    import glob
    single, merged, _ = pv_fp.load_fp_models(sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA, "fpmodels", "fp_*.pt"))), "cpu")
    models = (single, merged, "cpu")
    log(f"fp models: {len(models[0])} single + {len(models[1])} merged")

    qlib = QUERY_SETS[args.set]["lib"]
    held = set(truth.inchikey14)
    for sim in args.sims:
        t0 = time.time()
        L["row_p"] = base_row_p.copy()
        if sim == "c1":
            mask = lib == qlib
        else:
            mask = np.isin(ik, list(held))
        L["row_p"][mask] = -1
        log(f"[{sim}] masked {mask.sum():,} library rows")
        I = E.build_index(L)
        mols, recs = E.compute_channels(L, I, models, te)
        del I
        E.compute_frag(recs, args.workers)
        pickle.dump(dict(mids=[m for m, _ in mols], recs=recs, truth=truth, set=args.set, sim=sim,
                         seconds=time.time() - t0), open(cpath(f"recs_{args.set}_{sim}.pkl"), "wb"), protocol=4)
        log(f"[{sim}] done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# light stage
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def canon_map(E, idx, workers):
    """Tautomer-canonical InChIKey14 (the scorer's key) for pool indices, cached across runs."""
    from multiprocessing import Pool as MPool
    f = cpath("canon.pkl")
    cm = pickle.load(open(f, "rb")) if os.path.exists(f) else {}
    todo = [int(i) for i in np.unique(idx) if int(i) not in cm]
    if todo:
        with MPool(workers) as mp:
            ks = mp.map(E.canon_key, list(E.POOL["smiles"][todo]), chunksize=64)
        cm.update(zip(todo, ks)); pickle.dump(cm, open(f, "wb"), protocol=4)
    return cm


def reciprocal_ranks(sub, truth_key, smi_key, metric):
    """Per-molecule reciprocal rank, same rule as the official metric (first tautomer-canonical ik14 hit).
    smi_key caches the canonical key of pool SMILES; anything else is canonicalized by the metric itself."""
    rr = {}
    for mid, s in zip(sub.molecule_id, sub.smiles):
        k = truth_key[mid]; rr[mid] = 0.0
        for r, g in enumerate([x.strip() for x in s.split(";") if x.strip()][:25], 1):
            if g not in smi_key: smi_key[g] = metric.canonicalize_smiles_to_ik14(g)
            if smi_key[g] == k:
                rr[mid] = 1.0 / r; break
    return rr


def boot_se(v, n=2000, seed=0):
    v = np.asarray(v); rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    return float(np.std([v[rng.integers(0, len(v), len(v))].mean() for _ in range(n)]))


def channel_scores(E, recs):
    """Single-channel rankings from prvsiyan's 31 base features (no ranker)."""
    cols = {"lib": 0, "analog": 5, "fpnet f.z": 15, "metfrag": 21}
    out = {k: {} for k in cols}
    out["lib_shift"] = {}
    for r in recs:
        if not len(r["cand"]): continue
        X = E.blk_base(r, E.pool_fps(r["cand"]))
        for k, c in cols.items():
            out[k][r["mid"]] = X[:, c] + 1e-6 * X[:, 5]  # analog as tie-break
        out["lib_shift"][r["mid"]] = np.asarray(r["libsh"], np.float32) + 1e-6 * X[:, 5]
    return out


def pv_rows(path, drop_groups):
    z = np.load(path)
    keep = ~np.isin(z["G"], list(drop_groups))
    return z["X"][keep], z["Y"][keep], z["M"][keep]


def my_rows_(path, drop_sets):
    z = np.load(path, allow_pickle=True)
    keep = ~np.isin(z["Q"], [list(z["sets"]).index(s) for s in drop_sets])
    return z["X"][keep], z["Y"][keep], z["S"][keep], [str(b) for b in z["blocks"]]


def fit_A(E, X, Y, M, mult=1.0):
    """prvsiyan's ranker recipe: 2 class priors x 4 seeds (M = 0 marks Class-1 simulation rows).
    mult: extra per-row weight (used to up-weight our in-domain rows)."""
    return [E._hgb(X, Y, np.where(M == 0, w1, 1.0 - w1) * mult, sd, E.CFG.GBM) for w1 in (0.30, 0.60) for sd in (0, 1, 2, 3)]


def fit_B(E, X, Y, S, mult=1.0):
    """megayak's ranker recipe: RANK.W_A priors x RANK.SEEDS (S = 0 marks Class-1 simulation rows)."""
    return [E._hgb(X, Y, np.where(S == 0, wA, 1.0 - wA) * mult, sd, E.RANK.GBM) for wA in E.RANK.W_A for sd in E.RANK.SEEDS]


def own_rows(E, runs, blocks, use_fp):
    """Ranker rows from our own cached simulations, built by the same feature code the engine scores with.
    Returns X, Y, M (0 = Class-1 sim), and the molecule id of every row (for folds)."""
    Xs, Ys, Ms, Ids = [], [], [], []
    for sim, R in runs.items():
        for r in R["recs"]:
            if not len(r["cand"]) or r["truth_idx"] < 0: continue
            rr = r if use_fp else dict(r, zlog=None)
            cfp = E.pool_fps(r["cand"])
            X = np.hstack([E.BLOCKS[b](rr, cfp) for b in blocks]).astype(np.float32)
            y = np.zeros(len(X), np.float32); y[r["truth_idx"]] = 1
            Xs.append(X); Ys.append(y); Ms.append(np.full(len(X), 0 if sim == "c1" else 1)); Ids.append([r["mid"]] * len(X))
    return np.vstack(Xs), np.concatenate(Ys), np.concatenate(Ms), np.concatenate(Ids)


def np_groups_in_pv_rows(E, recs_c2, path):
    """prvsiyan's rank_train.npz has no query-set label, but its Class-2 groups for enveda-np-examples
    should reproduce our own Class-2 features. Match each of our molecules to the pv group whose
    true-candidate row is nearest (on channel columns that do not depend on the FP model)."""
    z = np.load(path)
    X, Y, G, M = z["X"], z["Y"], z["G"], z["M"]
    pos = (Y == 1) & (M == 1)
    gx, gX = G[pos], X[pos][:, [5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]]
    matched, dist = [], []
    for r in recs_c2:
        if not len(r["cand"]): continue
        tk = r.get("truth_idx", -1)
        if tk < 0: continue
        x = E.blk_base(dict(r, zlog=None), E.pool_fps(r["cand"]))[tk][[5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]]
        d = np.abs(gX - x).max(1); j = int(np.argmin(d))
        matched.append(int(gx[j])); dist.append(float(d[j]))
    return np.array(matched), np.array(dist)


def _E():
    import casmi_engine; return casmi_engine


def _pv():
    import pv; return pv


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stacker: in-domain (timsTOF) second stage over both rankers + library evidence.
# Measured 2026-09-24: +0.011 pred LB with the original candidate order, -0.004 +/- 0.004 once candidates are
# shuffled -- the whole gain was the position leak (see --shuffle). Kept as a harness method, not shipped.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class E_STACK:
    W_C1, W_C2 = 0.162, 0.271  # LB calibration shares: Class-1 / Class-2 simulation rows
    SEEDS = (0, 1)
    GBM = dict(max_depth=4, max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, min_samples_leaf=80)


def stack_features(r, a, b, w_pv=0.88):
    """Per-candidate rows for the stacker. a, b: Ranker A / Ranker B probabilities for r['cand'].
    Library evidence enters per candidate and as molecule context: a Class-2 answer never has library spectra,
    a Class-1 answer usually has the strongest (shifted) match and many spectra."""
    n = len(a); rn = lambda v: 1.0 - _pv()._rank_norm(v)
    ls, lib, cnt = np.asarray(r["libsh"], np.float32), np.asarray(r["lib"], np.float32), np.log1p(r["lib_cnt"])
    bl = w_pv * rn(a) + (1.0 - w_pv) * rn(b)
    j, kb = int(np.argmax(ls)), int(np.argmax(bl))
    per = [a, b, rn(a), rn(b), a - a.max(), b - b.max(), rn(bl), ls, rn(ls), ls - ls.max(), lib, lib - lib.max(),
           cnt, cnt - cnt.max(), (np.arange(n) == j).astype(np.float32)]
    mol = [ls.max(), np.sort(ls)[-2] if n > 1 else 0.0, cnt.max(), cnt[j], a.max(), b.max(), rn(bl)[j], ls[kb],
           float(j == kb), float(n)]
    return np.column_stack(per + [np.full(n, v) for v in mol]).astype(np.float32)


def fit_stacker(X, Y, S):
    """S = 0 Class-1 simulation rows, 1 = Class-2 (weighted by their LB shares)."""
    W = np.where(S == 0, E_STACK.W_C1, E_STACK.W_C2)
    return [_E()._hgb(X, Y, W, sd, E_STACK.GBM) for sd in E_STACK.SEEDS]


def score_stacker(recs, stackers, s_a, s_b):
    out = {}
    for r in recs:
        mid = r["mid"]
        if mid not in s_a: continue
        X = stack_features(r, s_a[mid], s_b[mid])
        out[mid] = np.mean([m.predict_proba(X)[:, 1] for m in stackers], axis=0) + 1e-6 * s_a[mid]
    return out


def score(args):
    import casmi_engine as E, metric
    metric.install_dependencies()
    E.POOL = pickle.load(open(cpath("pool.pkl"), "rb")); E.POOL["fp"] = np.load(cpath("pool_fp.npy"), mmap_mode="r")
    runs = {s: pickle.load(open(cpath(f"recs_{args.set}_{s}.pkl"), "rb")) for s in args.sims
            if os.path.exists(cpath(f"recs_{args.set}_{s}.pkl"))}
    truth = next(iter(runs.values()))["truth"]
    truth_key = {m: metric.canonicalize_smiles_to_ik14(s) for m, s in zip(truth.molecule_id, truth.normalized_smiles)}
    cm = canon_map(E, np.concatenate([r["cand"] for R in runs.values() for r in R["recs"]]), args.workers)
    smi_key = {E.POOL["smiles"][i]: k for i, k in cm.items()}
    if args.shuffle:
        # The pool is mass-sorted with a stable sort: same-formula isomers keep COCONUT-before-training order, and a
        # simulated answer is always a training structure. Shuffling candidates removes that position signal.
        rng = np.random.default_rng(args.shuffle)
        for R in runs.values():
            for r in R["recs"]:
                p = rng.permutation(len(r["cand"]))
                for k in PER_CAND:
                    if k in r: r[k] = np.asarray(r[k])[p]
    for R in runs.values():
        for r in R["recs"]:
            hit = [i for i, c in enumerate(r["cand"]) if cm.get(int(c)) == truth_key[r["mid"]]]
            r["truth_idx"] = hit[0] if hit else -1

    sfx = (f"_shuf{args.shuffle}" if args.shuffle else "") + (f"_npw{args.np_weight:g}" if args.np_weight != 1 else "")
    pv_rank = E.find("rank_train.npz"); my_rows = E.find("sim_rank_rows_nofp.npz")
    drop_A = set()
    if "c2" in runs:
        g, d = np_groups_in_pv_rows(E, runs["c2"]["recs"], pv_rank)
        exact = d < 1e-2
        drop_A = set(g[exact].tolist())
        # every confident match lands in groups 0..249 of 819: pv wrote the enveda-np-examples block first,
        # so hold out that whole block rather than only the molecules we could re-identify
        if args.set == "np" and drop_A and max(drop_A) < len(truth):
            drop_A = set(range(len(truth)))
        log(f"Ranker A rows: matched {exact.sum()}/{len(d)} of our Class-2 molecules to pv groups (max-abs dist < 1e-2; "
            f"{len(drop_A)} distinct groups, ids {min(drop_A, default=-1)}..{max(drop_A, default=-1)}); "
            f"distance quantiles 50/90/max {np.quantile(d, [.5, .9, 1]).round(4).tolist()}")
    t0 = time.time()

    def cached(key, fn):
        """Fitted GBMs keyed by what they were trained on (row file, dropped rows, engine GBM settings)."""
        import hashlib
        h = hashlib.md5(repr((key, E.CFG.GBM, E.RANK.GBM, E.RANK.W_A, E.RANK.SEEDS)).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        f = cpath(f"rankers_{h}.pkl")
        if os.path.exists(f): return pickle.load(open(f, "rb"))
        v = fn(); pickle.dump(v, open(f, "wb"), protocol=4); return v

    # As shipped: both row files contain these very np molecules (in-sample, optimistic reference).
    XA, YA, MA = pv_rows(pv_rank, set())
    XB, YB, SB, blocks = my_rows_(my_rows, [])
    shipped = {"A as shipped (in-sample)": (cached(("A-shipped", ()), lambda: fit_A(E, XA, YA, MA)), ["base"], True),
               "B as shipped (in-sample)": (cached(("B-shipped", ()), lambda: fit_B(E, XB, YB, SB)), blocks, False)}
    # Honest: K-fold by molecule. The shipped np rows are dropped and replaced by our own np rows (same feature
    # code) from the other folds, so every molecule is scored by rankers that never saw it but did see
    # in-domain timsTOF rows. Dropping np entirely instead measures domain shift, not generalisation.
    XA, YA, MA = pv_rows(pv_rank, drop_A)
    XB, YB, SB, _ = my_rows_(my_rows, ["np"] if args.set == "np" else [])
    oA = own_rows(E, runs, ["base"], True)
    oB = own_rows(E, runs, blocks, False)
    mids_all = np.array(sorted(truth.molecule_id))
    fold_of = dict(zip(mids_all, np.random.default_rng(0).permutation(len(mids_all)) % args.folds))
    fA, fB = np.array([fold_of[m] for m in oA[3]]), np.array([fold_of[m] for m in oB[3]])
    stamp = tuple(os.path.getmtime(cpath(f"recs_{args.set}_{s}.pkl")) for s in runs) + ((("shuffle", args.shuffle),) if args.shuffle else ()) \
        + ((("np_weight", args.np_weight),) if args.np_weight != 1 else ())
    # in-domain up-weighting: our own np rows get np_weight x the per-row weight of the shipped out-of-domain rows
    wA = lambda a: np.concatenate([np.ones(len(YA)), np.full(a.sum(), args.np_weight)])
    wB = lambda b: np.concatenate([np.ones(len(YB)), np.full(b.sum(), args.np_weight)])
    cv = []
    for f in range(args.folds):
        a, b = fA != f, fB != f
        mA = cached(("A-cv", args.set, f, args.folds, tuple(sorted(drop_A)), stamp),
                    lambda: fit_A(E, np.vstack([XA, oA[0][a]]), np.concatenate([YA, oA[1][a]]), np.concatenate([MA, oA[2][a]]), wA(a)))
        mB = cached(("B-cv", args.set, f, args.folds, stamp),
                    lambda: fit_B(E, np.vstack([XB, oB[0][b]]), np.concatenate([YB, oB[1][b]]), np.concatenate([SB, oB[2][b]]), wB(b)))
        cv.append((mA, mB))
        log(f"fold {f}: rankers ready ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)")

    # out-of-fold ranker scores for every molecule of every simulation
    oof = {}
    for sim, R in runs.items():
        oof[sim] = ({}, {})
        for f, (mA, mB) in enumerate(cv):
            rf = [r for r in R["recs"] if fold_of[r["mid"]] == f]
            oof[sim][0].update(E.score_molecules(rf, mA, ["base"], True))
            oof[sim][1].update(E.score_molecules(rf, mB, blocks, False))
    # Stacker: fitted on the out-of-fold ranker scores of the other folds' molecules (both simulations),
    # applied to this fold. Its rows are also exported so the notebook fits the same stacker on all of them.
    st = {"X": [], "Y": [], "S": [], "mid": []}
    for sim, R in runs.items():

            if not len(r["cand"]) or r["truth_idx"] < 0: continue
            X = stack_features(r, oof[sim][0][r["mid"]], oof[sim][1][r["mid"]])
            y = np.zeros(len(X), np.float32); y[r["truth_idx"]] = 1
            st["X"].append(X); st["Y"].append(y); st["S"].append(np.full(len(X), 0 if sim == "c1" else 1, np.int8))
            st["mid"].append(np.full(len(X), r["mid"], object))
    st = {k: (np.vstack(v) if k == "X" else np.concatenate(v)) for k, v in st.items()}
    fS = np.array([fold_of[m] for m in st["mid"]])
    stackers = [cached(("stack-cv", args.set, f, args.folds, stamp, repr(E_STACK.GBM), E_STACK.SEEDS, E_STACK.W_C1),
                       lambda: fit_stacker(st["X"][fS != f], st["Y"][fS != f], st["S"][fS != f])) for f in range(args.folds)]
    np.savez_compressed(cpath(f"stack_rows_{args.set}{sfx}.npz"), X=st["X"], Y=st["Y"], S=st["S"], mid=st["mid"].astype(str))
    # our own ranker rows for this set, in the shipped row formats (A: base + M, B: blocks + S), for the notebook
    np.savez_compressed(cpath(f"own_rows_{args.set}{sfx}.npz"), XA=oA[0], YA=oA[1], MA=oA[2], XB=oB[0], YB=oB[1], SB=oB[2],
                        blocks=np.array(blocks), midA=oA[3].astype(str), midB=oB[3].astype(str))
    log(f"stacker: {len(st['Y']):,} rows x {st['X'].shape[1]} features; rows exported")

    rows = []; rr_all = {}
    for sim, R in runs.items():
        recs = R["recs"]; mids = R["mids"]
        S = channel_scores(E, recs)
        for name, (models, bl, use_fp) in shipped.items():
            S[name] = E.score_molecules(recs, models, bl, use_fp)
        S["A cv"], S["B cv"] = oof[sim]
        S["blend 0.88 cv"] = E.blend_scores(S["A cv"], S["B cv"], 0.88)
        S["stack cv"] = {}
        for f in range(args.folds):
            rf = [r for r in recs if fold_of[r["mid"]] == f]
            S["stack cv"].update(score_stacker(rf, stackers[f], S["A cv"], S["B cv"]))
        S["blend 0.88 as shipped (in-sample)"] = E.blend_scores(S["A as shipped (in-sample)"], S["B as shipped (in-sample)"], 0.88)
        pickle.dump(S, open(cpath(f"scores_{args.set}_{sim}{sfx}.pkl"), "wb"), protocol=4)
        samp = cpath(f"sample_{args.set}.csv"); pd.DataFrame({"molecule_id": mids}).to_csv(samp, index=False)
        subs = E.make_submissions([(m, None) for m in mids], recs, S, samp, args.workers)
        sol = truth.rename(columns={"normalized_smiles": "smiles"})[["molecule_id", "smiles"]]
        ret = np.mean([r.get("truth_idx", -1) >= 0 for r in recs])
        ncand = np.median([len(r["cand"]) for r in recs])
        for name, sub in subs.items():
            rr = reciprocal_ranks(sub, truth_key, smi_key, metric)
            v = np.array([rr[m] for m in truth.molecule_id])
            if name == "blend 0.88 cv":
                official = metric.score(sol, sub, "molecule_id")
                assert abs(official - v.mean()) < 1e-9, (official, v.mean())
                sub.to_csv(cpath(f"sub_{args.set}_{sim}{sfx}.csv"), index=False)
            rr_all[(sim, name)] = v
            rows.append(dict(sim=sim, method=name, mrr=v.mean(), se=boot_se(v), top1=(v == 1).mean(),
                             top25=(v > 0).mean(), retention=ret, median_cand=ncand))
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    wide = df.pivot_table(index="method", columns="sim", values="mrr", sort=False)
    if {"c1", "c2"} <= set(wide.columns):
        wide["pred_LB"] = LB_A * wide["c1"] + LB_B * wide["c2"]
    pd.set_option("display.width", 200); pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 20)
    print("\n" + df.round(4).to_string(index=False))
    print("\n" + wide.round(4).to_string())
    if {"c1", "c2"} <= set(wide.columns):
        # paired difference vs the blend in predicted-LB units (same molecules in both sims -> resample molecules)
        base, rng, n = "blend 0.88 cv", np.random.default_rng(0), len(truth)
        for name in ("lib_shift", "stack cv"):
            d = LB_A * (rr_all[("c1", name)] - rr_all[("c1", base)]) + LB_B * (rr_all[("c2", name)] - rr_all[("c2", base)])
            print(f"paired dLB {name} vs {base}: {d.mean():+.4f} +/- {np.std([d[rng.integers(0, n, n)].mean() for _ in range(2000)]):.4f}")
    pickle.dump({f"{k[0]}|{k[1]}": v for k, v in rr_all.items()}, open(cpath(f"rr_{args.set}{sfx}.pkl"), "wb"))
    out = cpath(f"report_{args.set}{sfx}.csv"); df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    log(f"report -> {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("stage", choices=["build", "score"])
    ap.add_argument("--set", default="np", choices=sorted(QUERY_SETS))
    ap.add_argument("--sims", default="c1,c2")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--folds", type=int, default=5)
    ap.add_argument("--shuffle", type=int, default=1,
                    help="permute candidates within each molecule (seed; 0 = pool order, which leaks -- see score())")
    ap.add_argument("--np_weight", type=float, default=1.0,
                    help="sample-weight multiplier on our own in-domain (np) ranker rows in the CV fits")
    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=max(1, (os.cpu_count() or 4) - 2))
    a = ap.parse_args(); a.sims = a.sims.split(",")

", "c3sim.py": """"Class-3 simulation, stage 1: can derivative generation reach the answer at all?

Class 3 = the answer is in no database (not in PubChem). The engine scores 0 on it by construction: every
candidate comes from the pool. The only route is to generate new structures. Before building a generator
and a ranker for it, this measures the ceiling on the held-out np molecules.

Setup (reuses the cached Class-2 run, recs_{set}_c2.pkl): all library spectra of the query structure are
already removed there, so the spectral analogs in rec["ana"] are exactly what a Class-3 query would get.
The answer is then treated as absent from the pool: it can be neither a source nor a candidate.

For each molecule, apply a fixed set of natural-product transformations (hydroxylation, methylation,
glycosylation, acylation, redox, ...) to source structures, keep products within PPM_WIN of the query's
neutral mass, and check whether the answer's tautomer-canonical InChIKey14 (the scorer's key) is among
them. Sources:
  ana@k   the top-k spectral analogs the engine already computes (k = 1, 5, 20, 80)
  pool    every pool structure at target - delta for some transformation delta (oracle-free but large)
One step and two steps (analogs only). Reports reachability, the number of generated candidates per
molecule (dilution), and structural distance of the nearest analog.

  python c3sim.py [--set np] [--limit N] [--no-pool] [--two-step 1]
"""
import os, sys, time, pickle, argparse
from collections import Counter
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
CACHE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "data", "cache")
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

PPM = 10.0
M = {"C": 12.0, "H": 1.00782503207, "O": 15.99491461956, "N": 14.0030740048, "S": 31.97207100}


def mass(f):
    return sum(M[k] * v for k, v in f.items())


# name, forward reaction SMARTS (source >> product), formula delta. Reverse direction is listed separately.
# Stereo is ignored throughout: the scorer's key is InChIKey14 (connectivity).
HEX = "C1OC(CO)C(O)C(O)C1O"; DHEX = "C1OC(C)C(O)C(O)C1O"; PEN = "C1OCC(O)C(O)C1O"; GLA = "C1OC(C(=O)O)C(O)C(O)C1O"
HEX_P = "[CH1]1-[OX2]-[CH1](-[CH2]-[OH1])-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1]1-[OH1]"
DHEX_P = "[CH1]1-[OX2]-[CH1](-[CH3])-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1]1-[OH1]"
PEN_P = "[CH1]1-[OX2]-[CH2]-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1]1-[OH1]"
GLA_P = "[CH1]1-[OX2]-[CH1](-[CX3](=O)-[OH1])-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1](-[OH1])-[CH1]1-[OH1]"
ACYL = {  # O-acyl esters: name -> (SMILES of acyl group attached at O, SMARTS to remove it, formula delta)
    "acetyl": ("C(C)=O", "[CX3](=O)-[CH3]", dict(C=2, H=2, O=1)),
    "malonyl": ("C(=O)CC(=O)O", "[CX3](=O)-[CH2]-[CX3](=O)-[OH1]", dict(C=3, H=2, O=3)),
    "coumaroyl": ("C(=O)C=Cc1ccc(O)cc1", "[CX3](=O)-[CH1]=[CH1]-c1ccc(-[OH1])cc1", dict(C=9, H=6, O=2)),
    "caffeoyl": ("C(=O)C=Cc1ccc(O)c(O)c1", "[CX3](=O)-[CH1]=[CH1]-c1ccc(-[OH1])c(-[OH1])c1", dict(C=9, H=6, O=3)),
    "feruloyl": ("C(=O)C=Cc1ccc(O)c(OC)c1", "[CX3](=O)-[CH1]=[CH1]-c1ccc(-[OH1])c(-[OX2]-[CH3])c1", dict(C=10, H=8, O=3)),
    "galloyl": ("C(=O)c1cc(O)c(O)c(O)c1", "[CX3](=O)-c1cc(-[OH1])c(-[OH1])c(-[OH1])c1", dict(C=7, H=4, O=4)),
}
T = [
    ("hydroxyl_aliph", "[C;X4;!H0:1]>>[C:1]O", dict(O=1)),
    ("hydroxyl_arom", "[c;H1:1]>>[c:1]O", dict(O=1)),
    ("dehydroxyl", "[#6;!$([#6]=O):1]-[OX2H1]>>[#6:1]", dict(O=-1)),
    ("O_methyl", "[OX2H1:1]>>[O:1]C", dict(C=1, H=2)),
    ("N_methyl", "[NX3;H1,H2;!$(N[#6]=O):1]>>[N:1]C", dict(C=1, H=2)),
    ("C_methyl_arom", "[c;H1:1]>>[c:1]C", dict(C=1, H=2)),
    ("demethyl", "[O,N;X2,X3:1]-[CH3]>>[*:1]", dict(C=-1, H=-2)),
    ("hydrogenate", "[C:1]=[C:2]>>[C:1]-[C:2]", dict(H=2)),
    ("dehydrogenate", "[C;X4;!H0:1]-[C;X4;!H0:2]>>[C:1]=[C:2]", dict(H=-2)),
    ("keto_reduce", "[C;X3;$(C([#6])[#6]):1]=[OX1:2]>>[C:1]-[O:2]", dict(H=2)),
    ("alcohol_oxid", "[C;X4;H1:1]-[OX2H1:2]>>[C:1]=[O:2]", dict(H=-2)),
    ("hydrate", "[C:1]=[C:2]>>[C:1](O)-[C:2]", dict(H=2, O=1)),
    ("dehydrate", "[C;X4;!H0:1]-[C;X4:2]-[OX2H1]>>[C:1]=[C:2]", dict(H=-2, O=-1)),
    ("CH2_to_CO", "[C;X4;H2;R:1]>>[C:1]=O", dict(H=-2, O=1)),
    ("CH3_to_COOH", "[CH3;$(C[#6]):1]>>[C:1](=O)O", dict(H=-2, O=2)),
    ("sulfate", "[OX2H1:1]>>[O:1]S(=O)(=O)O", dict(S=1, O=3)),
    ("desulfate", "[OX2:1]-S(=O)(=O)-[OH1]>>[O:1]", dict(S=-1, O=-3)),
    ("prenyl_arom", "[c;H1:1]>>[c:1]CC=C(C)C", dict(C=5, H=8)),
    ("prenyl_O", "[OX2H1:1]>>[O:1]CC=C(C)C", dict(C=5, H=8)),
    ("deprenyl", "[c,O:1]-[CH2]-[CH1]=[CX3](-[CH3])-[CH3]>>[*:1]", dict(C=-5, H=-8)),
]
for nm, smi, pat, d in (("hexose", HEX, HEX_P, dict(C=6, H=10, O=5)), ("deoxyhexose", DHEX, DHEX_P, dict(C=6, H=10, O=4)),
                        ("pentose", PEN, PEN_P, dict(C=5, H=8, O=4)), ("glucuronide", GLA, GLA_P, dict(C=6, H=8, O=6))):
    T.append((f"+{nm}", f"[OX2H1:1]>>[O:1]{smi}", d))
    T.append((f"-{nm}", f"[OX2:1]-{pat}>>[O:1]", {k: -v for k, v in d.items()}))
for nm, (smi, pat, d) in ACYL.items():
    T.append((f"+{nm}", f"[OX2H1:1]>>[O:1]{smi}", d))
    T.append((f"-{nm}", f"[OX2:1]-{pat}>>[O:1]", {k: -v for k, v in d.items()}))
DELTA = np.array([mass(d) for _, _, d in T])

_w = {}


def _init():
    from rdkit import RDLogger
    from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
    RDLogger.DisableLog("rdApp.*")
    P = pickle.load(open(os.path.join(CACHE, "pool.pkl"), "rb"))
    _w["smiles"], _w["mass"] = P["smiles"], P["mass"]
    _w["rxn"] = [AllChem.ReactionFromSmarts(s) for _, s, _ in T]


def _key(m):
    import casmi_engine as E
    from rdkit import Chem
    try:
        return E.canon_key(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
    except Exception:
        return None


def _products(mol, ti):
    """All single-site products of transformation ti on mol, as sanitized mols with formula + plain ik14."""
    from rdkit import Chem
    from rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors import CalcMolFormula
    out = {}
    for ps in _w["rxn"][ti].RunReactants((mol,), maxProducts=200):
        p = ps[0]
        try:
            Chem.SanitizeMol(p); smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(p); p = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
            if p is None: continue
            k = Chem.MolToInchiKey(p)[:14]
        except Exception:
            continue
        if k and k not in out:
            out[k] = (p, CalcMolFormula(p))
    return out


def _mol(i):
    from rdkit import Chem
    return Chem.MolFromSmiles(_w["smiles"][int(i)])


def work(job):
    """job: dict(mid, target, truth_key, truth_formula, ana=[pool idx], pool_srcs=bool, two_step=bool)"""
    from rdkit.Chem.Descriptors import ExactMolWt
    t0 = time.time()
    tgt, tk, tf = job["target"], job["truth_key"], job["truth_formula"]
    tol = tgt * PPM / 1e6
    ana = [a for a in job["ana"] if a not in job["self_idx"]]
    res = dict(mid=job["mid"], n_ana=len(ana))
    # analog mass deltas vs the transformation table
    dm = tgt - _w["mass"][np.asarray(ana, np.int64)] if ana else np.zeros(0)
    res["delta_rank1"] = next((i for i, d in enumerate(dm) if np.abs(DELTA - d).min() <= tol), -1)
    res["same_mass_rank1"] = next((i for i, d in enumerate(dm) if abs(d) <= tol), -1)

    gen, hit = {}, {}  # plain ik14 -> (source rank or -1 for pool, route); hit route for the answer

    def consider(prods, rank, route):
        for k, (p, f) in prods.items():
            if abs(ExactMolWt(p) - tgt) > tol: continue
            if k not in gen: gen[k] = (rank, route)
            if f == tf and "first" not in hit and _key(p) == tk:
                hit["first"] = (rank, route)
    # one step from analogs (delta-matched transformations only)
    for r, (a, d) in enumerate(zip(ana, dm)):
        tis = np.where(np.abs(DELTA - d) <= tol)[0]
        if not len(tis): continue
        m = _mol(a)
        if m is None: continue
        for ti in tis:
            consider(_products(m, ti), r, T[ti][0])
    res["hit1_rank"] = hit["first"][0] if "first" in hit else -1
    res["hit1_route"] = hit["first"][1] if "first" in hit else ""
    res["gen1_ana"] = len(gen)
    # two steps from analogs: delta pairs
    if job["two_step"]:
        pair = DELTA[:, None] + DELTA[None, :]
        h2 = dict(hit)
        hit.clear()
        for r, (a, d) in enumerate(zip(ana, dm)):
            ij = np.argwhere(np.abs(pair - d) <= tol)
            if not len(ij): continue
            m = _mol(a)
            if m is None: continue
            cache = {}
            for i, j in ij:
                if i not in cache: cache[i] = _products(m, i)
                for k1, (p1, _) in list(cache[i].items())[:60]:
                    consider(_products(p1, j), r, f"{T[i][0]}>{T[j][0]}")
        res["hit2_rank"] = hit["first"][0] if "first" in hit else -1
        res["hit2_route"] = hit["first"][1] if "first" in hit else ""
        hit.clear(); hit.update(h2)
    res["gen12_ana"] = len(gen)
    # one step from every pool structure at target - delta (capped per transformation)
    if job["pool_srcs"]:
        gen_pool = {}
        hp = {}
        for ti, d in enumerate(DELTA):
            lo = np.searchsorted(_w["mass"], tgt - d - tol, "left"); hi = np.searchsorted(_w["mass"], tgt - d + tol, "right")
            for s in range(lo, min(hi, lo + 400)):
                if s in job["self_idx"]: continue
                m = _mol(s)
                if m is None: continue
                for k, (p, f) in _products(m, ti).items():
                    if abs(ExactMolWt(p) - tgt) > tol: continue
                    gen_pool.setdefault(k, T[ti][0])
                    if f == tf and "first" not in hp and _key(p) == tk:
                        hp["first"] = T[ti][0]
        res["hit_pool"] = hp.get("first", "")
        res["gen1_pool"] = len(gen_pool)
    res["sec"] = time.time() - t0
    return res


def tanimoto_nearest(jobs, truth_smiles):
    """Morgan-2 Tanimoto of the answer to its top analogs (how close the spectral neighbourhood is)."""
    from rdkit import Chem, DataStructs, RDLogger
    from rdkit.Chem import rdFingerprintGenerator
    RDLogger.DisableLog("rdApp.*")
    g = rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganGenerator(radius=2, fpSize=2048)
    P = pickle.load(open(os.path.join(CACHE, "pool.pkl"), "rb"))
    out = {}
    for j in jobs:
        t = Chem.MolFromSmiles(truth_smiles[j["mid"]])
        ana = [a for a in j["ana"] if a not in j["self_idx"]]
        fps = [g.GetFingerprint(m) for m in (Chem.MolFromSmiles(P["smiles"][a]) for a in ana) if m is not None]
        sims = DataStructs.BulkTanimotoSimilarity(g.GetFingerprint(t), fps) if fps and t is not None else [0.0]
        out[j["mid"]] = (sims[0] if sims else 0.0, max(sims[:5]), max(sims))
    return out


def main(a):
    import casmi_engine as E
    from rdkit import Chem
    from rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors import CalcMolFormula
    from multiprocessing import Pool as MPool
    R = pickle.load(open(os.path.join(CACHE, f"recs_{a.set}_c2.pkl"), "rb"))

    cm = pickle.load(open(os.path.join(CACHE, "canon.pkl"), "rb"))  # pool idx -> canonical ik14 (candidates only)
    jobs = []
    for r in R["recs"]:

        ana = [int(p) for p, _ in r["ana"]]
        # the answer is absent in Class 3: drop it (and tautomer twins) as a source
        tik = tik14[r["mid"]]
        self_idx = {i for i in ana + [int(c) for c in r["cand"]] if cm.get(i) == tk or P["keys"][i] in (tk, tik)}
        jobs.append(dict(mid=r["mid"], target=float(r["target"]), truth_key=tk,
                         truth_formula=CalcMolFormula(Chem.MolFromSmiles(tsmi[r["mid"]])),
                         ana=ana, self_idx=self_idx, pool_srcs=a.pool, two_step=a.two_step))
    if a.limit: jobs = jobs[:a.limit]
    t0 = time.time()
    with MPool(a.workers, initializer=_init) as mp:
        res = []

        f"{((df.delta_rank1 >= 0) & (df.delta_rank1 < k)).mean():.1%}" for k in (1, 5, 20, 80)))
    for col, lab in (("hit1_rank", "1 step"), ("hit2_rank", "2 steps")):
        if col in df:

    any_ana = (df.hit1_rank >= 0) | (df.get("hit2_rank", pd.Series(-1, df.index)) >= 0)

              f"union with analogs {(any_ana | (df.hit_pool != '')).mean():.1%}")

", "stage2.py": """"Class-3 stage 2: one-step analog products as extra candidates, measured on three simulations.

c3sim.py showed the answer of a Class-3 query (absent from every database) is a single NP transformation away
from one of the engine's top-80 spectral analogs for ~39% of np molecules. Here those products become candidates
with the engine's own features, and the net leaderboard effect is measured:

  c1  Class-1 simulation + generated candidates (dilution cost)
  c2  Class-2 simulation + generated candidates (dilution cost)
  c3  Class-3 simulation: the c2 run with the answer (and tautomer twins) removed from the pool and from the analog
      sources; the answer can only come back as a generated product.

Generated candidates get every per-candidate feature the pool candidates get -- fingerprint (FPNet f.z, analog
Tanimoto), MetFrag-lite scores, mass -- plus a `gen` block: generated flag, best source-analog spectral similarity,
1/(1+best source rank), number of distinct source analogs. Library features are 0 (no reference spectra exist).
A product that duplicates a candidate already in the window (tautomer-canonical InChIKey14) is dropped.

  python stage2.py gen   [--set np]                  # products + features -> cache/gen_{set}.pkl
  python stage2.py score [--set np] [--c3_weight 1]   # rankers, three sims, report

Methods in the report:
  base            the honest harness baseline (cached CV rankers, pool candidates only; c3 = 0 by construction)
  base+gen        the same rankers applied to pool + generated candidates (rankers never saw generated rows)
  gen A/B/blend   CV rankers refit with the gen block and our own c1/c2/c3 rows (c3 rows x --c3_weight)
"""
import os, sys, time, pickle, argparse, copy, hashlib
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import harness as H  # sets CASMI_ROOTS
from harness import cpath, log
import c3sim as C3
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

GEN_COLS = ("gen", "gen_sim", "gen_rinv", "gen_nsrc")
LIB_COLS = ("lib", "lib_mean", "libsh", "lib_cnt")
FRAG_COLS = ("frag", "frag_ad", "frag_mean", "frag_pol")
PER_CAND = H.PER_CAND + GEN_COLS
# Class-3 value in LB units: everything that is neither Class-1 (0.162) nor Class-2 x pool recall (0.271).
# An upper bound: np answers are known COCONUT compounds whose relatives stay in the pool (see c3sim.py).
LB_C = 1.0 - H.LB_A - H.LB_B


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# gen: products per molecule
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _init():
    from rdkit import RDLogger
    from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
    import casmi_engine as E
    RDLogger.DisableLog("rdApp.*")
    C3._w["rxn"] = [AllChem.ReactionFromSmarts(s) for _, s, _ in C3.T]
    # fp_and_mass only initialises its generators while casmi_engine._g is empty; a forked (Linux) worker inherits
    # the parent's _g, already holding the tautomer enumerator from canon_key, and would silently return None
    E._fp_init()


def work(job):
    """job: sim, mid, target, src = [(smiles, mass, rank, spectral sim)]. All one-step products within PPM of the
    target, aggregated per plain InChIKey14 (best source rank / similarity, distinct sources)."""
    from rdkit import Chem
    from rdkit.Chem.Descriptors import ExactMolWt
    import casmi_engine as E, pv
    tgt = job["target"]; tol = tgt * C3.PPM / 1e6
    agg = {}
    for smi, m0, rank, s in job["src"]:
        tis = np.where(np.abs(C3.DELTA - (tgt - m0)) <= tol)[0]
        if not len(tis): continue
        mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
        if mol is None: continue
        for ti in tis:
            for k, (p, _) in C3._products(mol, ti).items():
                if abs(ExactMolWt(p) - tgt) > tol: continue
                a = agg.get(k)
                if a is None:
                    agg[k] = a = dict(smiles=Chem.MolToSmiles(p), rank=rank, sim=s, src=set(), route=C3.T[ti][0])
                a["rank"] = min(a["rank"], rank); a["sim"] = max(a["sim"], s); a["src"].add(rank)
    out = []
    for k, a in agg.items():
        fm = E.fp_and_mass(a["smiles"])
        ck = E.canon_key(a["smiles"])
        if fm is None or ck is None: continue
        out.append(dict(ik=k, ckey=ck, smiles=a["smiles"], fp=fm[0], mass=fm[1], rank=a["rank"], sim=a["sim"],
                        nsrc=len(a["src"]), route=a["route"], fm=pv.frag_masses_safe(a["smiles"])))
    return job["sim"], job["mid"], out


def query_specs(set_name):
    """Per-molecule spectra exactly as compute_channels builds them (compute_frag pops them from the cached recs)."""
    te, _ = H.build_queries(set_name)
    out = {}
    for mid, sub in te.groupby("molecule_id", sort=True):
        specs = []
        for r in sub.itertuples():
            a_ = np.asarray(r.ms2_mzs, np.float32); b_ = np.asarray(r.ms2_normalized_intensities, np.float32)
            k_ = a_ <= float(r.precursor_mz) + 2.0
            a_, b_ = a_[k_], b_[k_]
            specs.append((a_, b_ / b_.max() if len(b_) and b_.max() > 0 else b_))
        out[mid] = specs
    return out


def frag_feats(r, specs, fms):
    """compute_frag's four MetFrag-lite scores for a list of fragment-mass arrays."""
    import pv
    from pv import CFG
    peaks = []
    for a_, b_ in specs:
        m2, i2 = pv._clean(a_, b_, CFG.INT_FLOOR, CFG.MAX_PEAKS, 1.0, False)
        peaks.append((np.asarray(m2, float), np.asarray(i2, float)))
    F1 = np.zeros((len(fms), max(len(peaks), 1)), np.float32); F2 = np.zeros_like(F1); F3 = np.zeros_like(F1)
    for j, fm in enumerate(fms):
        for k, (x, y) in enumerate(peaks):
            F1[j, k] = pv.explain_score(fm, x, y, mode=r["mode"], tol=CFG.MZ_TOL)
            F2[j, k] = pv.explain_score_adduct(fm, x, y, r["adducts"][k], tol=CFG.MZ_TOL)
            F3[j, k] = pv.explain_score(fm, x, y, mode=r["modes"][k], tol=CFG.MZ_TOL)
    return dict(frag=F1.max(1), frag_ad=F2.max(1), frag_mean=F3.mean(1), frag_pol=F3.max(1))


def self_indices(r, P, cm, tk, tik):
    """Pool entries that are the answer under the scorer's key (or its plain ik14): absent in Class 3."""
    return {i for i in [int(p) for p, _ in r["ana"]] + [int(c) for c in r["cand"]]
            if cm.get(i) == tk or P["keys"][i] in (tk, tik)}


def finalize(r, prods, specs, cm, P, drop=()):
    """One molecule's products -> the generated-candidate block: drop duplicates of window candidates (tautomer-canonical
    ik14 or plain ik14; `drop` = pool entries removed from the window) and of each other, then MetFrag-lite features."""
    cand = [int(c) for c in r["cand"] if int(c) not in drop]
    have = {cm.get(c) for c in cand} | {P["keys"][c] for c in cand}
    seen, keep = set(), []
    for p in sorted(prods, key=lambda p: (p["rank"], -p["sim"], p["ckey"])):
        if p["ckey"] in have or p["ik"] in have or p["ckey"] in seen: continue
        seen.add(p["ckey"]); keep.append(p)
    g = dict(smiles=[p["smiles"] for p in keep], ckey=[p["ckey"] for p in keep], ik=[p["ik"] for p in keep],
             mass=np.array([p["mass"] for p in keep]), route=[p["route"] for p in keep],
             fp=np.stack([p["fp"] for p in keep]) if keep else np.zeros((0, 867), np.uint8),
             gen_sim=np.array([p["sim"] for p in keep], np.float32),
             gen_rinv=np.array([1.0 / (1 + p["rank"]) for p in keep], np.float32),
             gen_nsrc=np.array([p["nsrc"] for p in keep], np.float32))
    g.update(frag_feats(r, specs, [p["fm"] for p in keep]) if keep else {k: np.zeros(0, np.float32) for k in FRAG_COLS})
    return g


def run_products(jobs, workers):
    from multiprocessing import Pool as MPool
    t0 = time.time(); res = {}
    with MPool(workers, initializer=_init) as mp:
        for i, (sim, mid, out) in enumerate(mp.imap_unordered(work, jobs, chunksize=1)):
            res[(sim, mid)] = out
            if i % 100 == 0: log(f"  products {i}/{len(jobs)} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)")
    return res


def gen(a):
    import casmi_engine as E, metric, pv
    metric.install_dependencies()
    P = pickle.load(open(cpath("pool.pkl"), "rb"))
    runs = {s: pickle.load(open(cpath(f"recs_{a.set}_{s}.pkl"), "rb")) for s in ("c1", "c2")}
    E.POOL = P  # canon_map reads POOL["smiles"]; builds cache/canon.pkl on a fresh machine
    cm = H.canon_map(E, np.concatenate([r["cand"] for R in runs.values() for r in R["recs"]]), a.workers)
    truth = runs["c2"]["truth"]
    tsmi, tik14 = dict(zip(truth.molecule_id, truth.normalized_smiles)), dict(zip(truth.molecule_id, truth.inchikey14))
    tkey = {m: metric.canonicalize_smiles_to_ik14(s) for m, s in tsmi.items()}
    agree = np.mean([E.canon_key(tsmi[m]) == k for m, k in tkey.items()])
    log(f"truth keys: engine canon_key agrees with the metric on {agree:.1%}")
    jobs, drop = [], {}
    for sim in ("c1", "c2", "c3"):
        for r in runs["c1" if sim == "c1" else "c2"]["recs"]:
            if "target" not in r: continue
            ana = [(int(p), float(s)) for p, s in r["ana"]]
            if sim == "c3":
                si = self_indices(r, P, cm, tkey[r["mid"]], tik14[r["mid"]])
                drop[r["mid"]] = si
                ana = [(p, s) for p, s in ana if p not in si]
            src = [(P["smiles"][p], float(P["mass"][p]), rank, s) for rank, (p, s) in enumerate(ana)]
            jobs.append(dict(sim=sim, mid=r["mid"], target=float(r["target"]), src=src))
    del P["k2i"]
    res = run_products(jobs, a.workers)
    specs = query_specs(a.set)
    # the rebuilt spectra must reproduce the cached MetFrag scores of pool candidates
    chk = []
    for r in runs["c2"]["recs"][:20]:
        if not len(r["cand"]): continue
        f = frag_feats(r, specs[r["mid"]], [pv.frag_masses_safe(P["smiles"][int(c)]) for c in r["cand"][:5]])
        chk.append(max(np.abs(f[k] - np.asarray(r[k])[:5]).max() for k in FRAG_COLS))
    log(f"MetFrag reproduction on cached pool candidates: max abs diff {max(chk):.2e}")
    assert max(chk) < 1e-5
    G = {s: {} for s in ("c1", "c2", "c3")}; stats = []
    for sim in G:
        for r in runs["c1" if sim == "c1" else "c2"]["recs"]:
            if (sim, r["mid"]) not in res: continue
            g = finalize(r, res[(sim, r["mid"])], specs[r["mid"]], cm, P, drop[r["mid"]] if sim == "c3" else ())
            if sim == "c3": g["drop"] = sorted(drop[r["mid"]])
            G[sim][r["mid"]] = g
            hit = tkey[r["mid"]] in g["ckey"]
            stats.append(dict(sim=sim, mid=r["mid"], n_raw=len(res[(sim, r["mid"])]), n_gen=len(g["smiles"]), answer_generated=hit,
                              answer_route=g["route"][g["ckey"].index(tkey[r["mid"]])] if hit else ""))
    pickle.dump(dict(G=G, truth_key=tkey), open(cpath(f"gen_{a.set}.pkl"), "wb"), protocol=4)
    st = pd.DataFrame(stats); st.to_csv(cpath(f"gen_stats_{a.set}.csv"), index=False)
    assert st.n_gen.sum() > 0 and st[st.sim == "c3"].answer_generated.any(), "no products generated"
    for sim, d in st.groupby("sim"):
        log(f"[{sim}] generated per molecule (after dedup vs window): median {d.n_gen.median():.0f}, mean {d.n_gen.mean():.1f}, "
            f"max {d.n_gen.max()}; raw median {d.n_raw.median():.0f}; answer among generated {d.answer_generated.mean():.1%}")
    log(f"gen -> {cpath(f'gen_{a.set}.pkl')}")
